analogy.rationale: Tyrosine hydroxylase is the rate-limiting enzyme for catecholamine synthesis, but these cell lines are not neuronal and express little TH, so inhibitors should produce minimal transcriptional response; other catecholamine-pathway drugs are listed only as weak/low-similarity analogs because they also act on poorly expressed targets.
